review_metadata.scope: Frozen local source snapshot and assigned local ItemBody HTML preview only. No live website, HTTP(S), item edits, publication-status changes, build, test, or gate.

findings.symptom: The local HTML/preview displays the `~~~tikz` block contents as literal TeX/TikZ text instead of a trellis drawing.
findings.diagram_math: Correct against source prose and verification: nodes s,a,b,c,t; edges s→a,s→b (2 each), a→t,b→t (3 each), c→t (100); c is unreachable because it has no incoming edge.

findings.symptom: The local HTML/preview displays the center/TikZ source as literal text rather than the intended state-preparation diagram; the raw source spans screenshot tiles 01 and 02.
findings.diagram_math: Correct against the diagram convention: a central state-preparation map C→H_A⊗H_B⊗H_C taking 1 to |GHZ⟩ with ordered outgoing legs A,B,C, representing one joint state.

source_supported_diagram_candidates.rationale: The definition explicitly separates the data and erasure-flag output summands and gives their weighted channel contributions.
source_supported_diagram_candidates.concrete_content: Show an input operator X on A entering E_{d,ε}; split into a data branch labelled (1−ε)JXJ* in the A data summand and an erasure branch labelled ε tr(X)|e⟩⟨e| in the orthogonal C e summand. Label e⊥A and dim(B)=d+1.
source_supported_diagram_candidates.uncertainty: Optional explanatory diagram; the equation and prose already state the definition completely.

source_supported_diagram_candidates.rationale: The statement and facts give the source/channel alphabets, block maps, blocklength ratio, and threshold relation explicitly.
source_supported_diagram_candidates.concrete_content: Draw S^k → encoder f_k → X^{n_k} → finite DMC W^{⊗n_k} → Y^{n_k} → decoder g_k → Ŝ^k. Label source law P_S^{⊗k}, n_k/k→ρ, and the achievability threshold H(P_S)<ρC(W); distinguish this strict condition from the converse H(P_S)≤ρC(W).
source_supported_diagram_candidates.uncertainty: Optional overview diagram; it would summarize the existing block-code interfaces and theorem thresholds, not add a premise.
